title: Calibrated Task-Routed LoRA Banks: Disentangling Routing Mode and Adapter-Birth Initialization for Continual Image Restoration
abstract: Continual image restoration requires models to absorb new degradation types without catastrophic forgetting. This work disentangles routing mode from adapter-birth initialization in a LoRA-bank architecture, introducing a calibrated routing scheme that stabilizes adaptation across sequential tasks.

title: SABLE: Sparse-View Interpretable 3D Animal Behavior Representations for Neural Encoding and Decoding
abstract: SABLE produces interpretable 3D animal-behavior representations from sparse multi-view video through cross-view geometry initialization and keypoint-assisted camera calibration, then evaluates these representations as substrates for neural encoding and decoding.

title: Towards Reliable VLM Judges: State-Conditional Invariance and Presentation-Aware Diagnostics
abstract: Diagnoses failure modes of vision-language model judges under benign presentation changes, introducing state-conditional invariance criteria and presentation-aware diagnostic protocols.

title: GridWM-Judge: Evaluating Vision-Language Model Judges in Grid Worlds via World Model Deficits
authors: Qinan Zhang*, Qihang Jin*, et al.
abstract: Vision-language models are increasingly used as automated judges to score agent trajectories, yet their verdicts are brittle to benign changes in wording, evidence order, or rendering. GridWM-Judge decomposes evaluation into atomic prediction, scene perception, and judging tasks across controlled trajectory triplets in six MiniGrid environments.

title: Multimodal Representation Learning and Fusion
authors: Qihang Jin, Enze Ge, Yuhang Xie, Hongying Luo, Junhao Song, Ziqian Bi, Chia Xin Liang, Jibin Guan, Joe Yeong, Junfeng Hao
abstract: A survey of multimodal representation learning and fusion, covering alignment methods, cross-modal fusion strategies, and shared-feature learning across vision, text, and audio modalities.

title: From Memory to Alignment: A Comprehensive Review of Large Language Model Optimization
authors: Enze Ge, Qihang Jin, Yuhang Xie, et al.
abstract: A systematic review of large language model optimization techniques, spanning memory efficiency, fine-tuning strategies, and alignment mechanisms that improve performance while reducing computational cost.

title: Effect of Brain-Computer Interface on Limb Motor Function after Intracerebral Hemorrhage in Basal Ganglia and Its Rehabilitation Mechanism
abstract: Investigates the effect of brain-computer interface intervention on limb motor function recovery after intracerebral hemorrhage in basal ganglia, with attention to underlying rehabilitation mechanisms.
